Thanks Sean — reviewed the redline. High-level legal position and suggested contract language below (summary first, bullets to track in redline):

Summary position: Redwood will provide an annual SOC 2 Type II report and an evidence bundle on request; we will not permit unfettered on-prem or production-level privileged access. We will offer a bounded inspection model with the following constraints:

- Inspection scope limited to defined artifacts and systems listed in an appendix; no live access to customer data stores unless specifically required and separately approved.
- Notice: 30 calendar days' written notice for any staging/ephemeral access and 45 days for hybrid tests requiring reserved infra.
- Background checks: third-party testers must comply with our contractor screening process; Vendor NDA + limited-scope SOW required for live testing.
- Evidence transfer: secure SharePoint/Box link with time-limited credentials; we will provide an evidence manifest mapping artifacts to SOC 2 controls.
- Privileged access: explicit clause prohibiting permanent privileged admin access; any temporary accounts will be time-boxed and logged; remote session monitoring will be enabled.

Redline action items I've added to the doc: explicit definition of "bounded inspection", a sample evidence manifest format, and a provision that Redwood may redact internal operational telemetry not relevant to customer controls. If Orchard insists on unrestricted inspection language, escalate to Legal leadership — we will treat as a negotiated exception tied to commercial concessions.

Attachments: Security_Exhibit_Suggested_Wording.docx, PenTest_Access_Parameters.pdf

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Adding the ops perspective — what we can deliver and how long it takes:

Proposed operational lanes:
1) Evidence bundle (no live access) — contents: current SOC2 Type II PDF + cover letter, configuration snapshots (last-30-days), audit/log extracts (30 days), network diagram, IAM snapshot, and a manifest. Delivery: initial package within 10 business days; subsequent requests baseline 5 business days.

2) Bounded staging test — ephemeral environment we can stand up for testing with scoped credentials, prerecorded data subset, and session monitoring. Requires 30 calendar days notice for scheduling, we reserve the right to require a brief ops playbook review call and background checks for testers.

3) Full staging/on-prem inspection — only by exception. If customer wants this, ops needs 45 days to prepare and we will require a commercial agreement (SOW) and a one-off operations fee.

Practical notes: we cannot provide production-level admin credentials. Logs we can include: auditd/syscall aggregates, API access logs (token masked), KMS usage summary. We will not share raw PII; anything containing customer data will be sanitized and described in the manifest.

I've attached an evidence_manifest_template.xlsx you can share with Orchard so they see the format.

Monica Patel
Head of Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
